title: The route is ready on the watch
description: The line you chose and the details you need open on the device itself before you set out.

blocks.text: The user expected the watch version to let them leave the phone at home, and found out otherwise only when they tried to use it. The condition of standalone operation has to refer to a specific route and a specific device.

quote.text: Although it has an Apple watch version, for now it requires your phone with you too. I was excited until I tried it on my watch and discovered that little caveat. blocks.text: Test the chosen route on the watch

Send the line and the available maps in advance. On the watch, show what they contain, let the stretch you need be opened without the phone, and start the recording. Handing the result over after you get back is a separate step.
Explain the dependency before setting out
If the phone is needed to prepare, to start or to carry on, name that stage outright. The presence of an app on the watch should not by itself amount to a promise of standalone navigation.
